args.name: friction-fire-trial
args.function: Attempt to produce an ember or small heat source through a physically modeled friction trial using suitable owned wood. Inspect material suitability first; allow failure when materials, moisture, geometry or effort are inadequate.
args.conditions: My thermal assessment at tick 174 found no reachable heat source and reported heat-source, exposure-support and heat-transfer missing. Heating is not represented by the existing food interface. Fallen branches are visible nearby, but I have not tested their suitability and hold no fuel or ignition equipment. I am outdoors on ordinary soil, healthy, with energy about 39.4.
args.inputs: Candidate wood gathered through ordinary actions; any additional material or apparatus must actually be obtained. Suitable wood types, required geometry and other prerequisites are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown realistic study, preparation, effort and duration. Charge actual work and consumed materials, retain paid progress where appropriate, and permit cancellation. Refuse unsafe or physically unsupported attempts.
args.effects: If genuinely feasible and successful, create a bounded, observable ember or heat source with actual fuel consumption, duration and hazards. Otherwise report the observed failure or missing prerequisite. Do not heat food, guarantee ignition, grant food safety, create tools or award mastery merely for requesting this.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
candidates.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Lay one carried loose unit on clear ground within reach at a chosen point and angle, as a ground item anyone can pick up; inspect the unit and site first.
candidates.costs: Study: 1 round, 0.2 energy. inspect: target (your carried item), optional x, y and angle (radians); 1 round, 0.2 energy; reports the unit and site facts. place: target, x, y, angle, quantity 1 (one unit at a time). Round 1 is the same paid inspection (0.2) and reserves the unit, still carried; round 2 moves and orients it through ordinary drop (0.5): 2 rounds, 0.7 energy in all. inspect-progress: 1 round, 0.2. resume continues the unpaid round 2 after fresh checks; cancel: 1 round, no energy; both use only mode. Refusals come before any cost; travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Needs a represented shape: branch, birch and oak units are the declared rod of small-combustion-source@1 (900 kg/m3, length 25 diameters; a branch is about 0.04 x 0.99 m), straight and rigid. Other materials, bending willow, worked, combined or partial units are reported as unknown shape and cannot be placed. Handling: a unit you carry whose rod fits a two-handed grip (1.5-5 cm thick). Site: the centre within your reach (body radius + 0.65), the whole footprint inside the world, on firm visible ground (not water, a wet bank or waterlogged), clear of people (you included), objects, placed units and loose ground items. Placing debits exactly that unit and lays it, with its material, origin and age, as one ground item (the new id that drop gives, mapped) at x, y and the angle, plus a footprint record others see; nothing is copied, merged, shaped, joined or fastened. Another action, an obstruction, lost reach or low energy pauses before round 2 without charge; a changed unit or ground ends the work (place again). Cancel or death releases the unit once; nothing is refunded. Recover it with pickup; the footprint record ends when the item is taken or moved. No reward, comfort or skill gain.

candidates.function: Prepare whole units of your own food without heat, water or tools: each paid round checks one held unit by eye, brushes it by hand and moves it into your prepared lot; inspect food or progress; cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Prepare: inputStackId is the exact item id of your own edible food stack, quantity the whole units to prepare (at most its whole units); one round and 0.5 energy per unit, so 7 units take 7 rounds and 3.5 energy. Every round is checked before any charge; prepare resumes your paused work (inputStackId and quantity may be omitted). Inspect (inputStackId of your own food) and inspect-progress (your latest preparation): one round, 0.2 energy, no food used. Cancel: one round, no energy. No vessel, water, fuel, tool or ground surface is used or given. Eating and giving use eat and give at their own costs.
candidates.effects: Each paid round separates one whole unit from the input, checks it by eye and brushes it by hand, held, never set on the ground. A usable unit joins one owned lot of the same food with unchanged quantity, origin, age, decay, nutrition and toxicity, recorded as raw, unheated, dry-brushed, safety unknown. Loose soil on food is not represented, so no debris is measured or removed and no cleanliness is claimed. A spoiled unit is reported unsuitable, stays unprepared and ends the work. Nothing is cooked, peeled, washed, made safe or kept fresher; food keeps ageing, and the planting trial treats prepared units as processed. The lot holds only completed units. Inspections record visible condition, treatment and your own eating record (not a safety test) as an unverified personal record. An unworked round, too little energy, or an input no longer yours with a whole unit pauses without charge. Cancel or death ends the work; completed units stay. No refund or reward; nobody is fed.

candidates.function: Assess whether your own food could be heat-treated: one paid look records its visible condition and treatment and which supplied or reachable prerequisites (heat source, support, tool, vessel, water, evidence) are present, unverified or missing. Heating is unavailable in this world version and is refused at no cost.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Assess: inputStackId is the exact item id of your own unreserved food, quantity the amount considered (0.1 steps; default all of it); one round and 0.2 energy. No food, fuel, tool, vessel or water is used, moved or reserved. Optional sourceId, apparatusIds (up to 4 exact ids of your items, ground items or objects within reach) and evidenceKey (an exact key of your own records) are only checked. Heat: refused before any cost. A wrong id, non-food, too large a quantity or energy below 0.2 fails at no cost.
candidates.effects: Assess writes an unverified personal record and an event: the food quantity, origin, age, decay, visible condition and treatment records; your own eating record of that food (not a test of this stack); for each supplied id whether it is absent or present (a source with or without represented heat, otherwise role unverified); any object within reach with available heat; water in your cell; whether the evidence key exists; and the missing prerequisites. It never labels food cooked, edible or safe: safety stays unknown, and heat would not prove edibility or remove hazards. It does not show that no heat source exists elsewhere. Nothing changes except your energy and records. No reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general friction-heating trial with inspection and progress modes. The supplied searches found no equivalent friction or ignition capability; the failed exact lookup for small-combustion-source does not establish that combustion support exists. probe supports observation and small physical tests but does not specify sustained friction, thermal state or ember persistence. thermal-food-preparation only assesses food prerequisites; position-loose-material only places existing rods. Neither supplies ignition. The smallest executable version is a measured trial using actually obtainable, physically suitable contact surfaces, with warming or informative failure as legitimate outcomes and ignition only when implemented physical conditions support it. Wren currently owns no wood or apparatus; visible branches are not owned inputs, and another actor's placed branch is not available by assumption. Missing thermal mechanisms go to the current-conversation development handoff, without advancing the world.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: friction-heating-trial(targetIds, mode, quantity, effortRounds), learnable by any applicable actor. Modes: inspect, trial, inspect-progress, resume, cancel. Accept exact item IDs for owned, reachable wood pieces and any genuinely available support or apparatus; no actor-, species- or specimen-specific interface. Initially support direct manual rubbing of two suitable existing pieces, without silently converting rods into a spindle, hearth board, tinder or tools. Unsupported geometry must produce an explicit prerequisite failure, not simulated fire. Broader apparatus may be accepted only when its actual mechanics are represented.\\nCosts: individual study takes 4 rounds and 0.2 energy per completed study round. Inspection and inspect-progress take 1 round and 0.2 energy; reserve nothing and consume no material. Trial begins with a paid inspection unless an unchanged, still-applicable inspection is already attached to the work record. Each rubbing round costs 0.8 energy and one round of simulation time; effortRounds is an integer from 1 to 10 per submitted bout. Further bouts require a fresh reach, material, safety and energy check. Invalid IDs, absent ownership, impossible contact geometry or insufficient energy fail before a trial charge. Gathering, transport, obtaining apparatus and any independently supported shaping action have their own existing costs. No preparation tool, fuel, stock or ignition equipment is supplied. Cancel takes one round and no energy. No implementation or review time advances simulation.\\nPrerequisites and applicability: inspect the selected material, represented dimensions, accessible contact surfaces, condition, observable moisture evidence, grip and support, and a clear reachable ground location. Record unknown species, moisture or geometry as unknown, never disclose hidden resource attributes as inspected facts. A visible branch source such as canopy-26 still requires ordinary gathering. item-142-wren-1713, item-62-wren-728, item-133-wren-1564 and item-150-wren-1830 are food, not supplied friction apparatus. placed-132-sol-1554 is neither Wren's owned input nor a free support. If material parameters needed for a defensible calculation are unavailable, implement the conservative measured-trial precursor and report the unverified parameter; do not infer dry, ignition-suitable wood. Refuse unsafe placement or effort before charging; stop if conditions become unsafe.\\nPhysical implementation: add the missing bounded contact-heating and cooling process in this handoff. Resolve force, stroke distance and achievable speed from supported geometry and the actor's bounded effort; friction work cannot exceed mechanical input. Split this work between the two contact bodies and losses; subtract conduction, convection, radiation and moisture evaporation from their actual thermal states. Use engine simulation-time units consistently. The implementation must publish and test its force, friction, heat-capacity, moisture, wear, cooling and ignition parameters before enabling the relevant result; do not use a fixed number of paid rounds as an ignition recipe. A conservative trial may produce only transient warmth or abrasion. Unknown material properties cannot be silently replaced with properties guaranteeing ignition. Material wear debits the actual source mass and records recoverable residue and environmental loss; do not require probe's generic 0.1-unit sample consumption on top of real wear. Keep material quantity, mass, origin, age and ownership consistent with the existing item ledger; if existing units cannot represent fractional wear, add that accounting dependency rather than round up or duplicate material.\\nIgnition is conditional, not the minimum promised result: enable it only when represented contact material or actual collected residue reaches a validated ignition condition with adequate oxygen, moisture and retained heat. Consume the measured ignited mass from its original item or residue and create exactly one spatially located ember/source referencing that debit and the work record. Its chemical energy is bounded by remaining combustible mass and its supported fuel parameters; friction is not free combustion energy. An ember is not automatically a flame. Fuel consumption, heat release, cooling, extinction and hazards run through a persistent coded process each world tick, even after cancellation or death. No positive heat release with zero fuel; no automatic refuelling, spread, shelter heating or food heating. Where a burn or exposure effect is enabled, it must use the same conserved heat and actual proximity, not a narrative claim. Unsupported transfer paths remain unavailable.\\nProgress and lifecycle: each paid round records exact input IDs and revisions, contact geometry, effort, elapsed time, material debits, thermal state, observations and stop reason. Reserve the active contact items against simultaneous use; no double spending. Interrupted rubbing stops mechanical input immediately and releases or safely retains reservations through the existing work-lock mechanism; all cooling and any real combustion continue. Resume revalidates ownership, reach, energy, condition and geometry and continues the actual cooled state, not a saved hot checkpoint. Leaving reach, inadequate energy or missing support pauses without charging an unperformed round. Changed, destroyed or transferred inputs invalidate the affected work. Cancel or death ends actor work, releases reservations once and leaves real residues and sources in the world; ordinary death inventory handling applies. Completed abrasion, expended effort and consumed fuel are never refunded. No charge for unperformed work and no refund or regeneration of spent materials. Another participant must communicate, learn where required and act independently; the trial cannot commandeer their possessions or assistance.\\nDependencies and reuse: record reuse of probe's observation/evidence conventions where applicable, existing gather/pickup/drop and ownership accounting, existing action scheduling and work locks, and the rod geometry explicitly referenced by position-loose-material as small-combustion-source@1. That reference is evidence of geometry only, not an available ignition function. Inspect full implementation facts in the development handoff and reuse any actual thermal or combustion code discovered there, with its exact revision recorded. Retain thermal-food-preparation's assessment contract unchanged. All validated limits, progress rules, cooling, combustion and accounting checks execute in code rather than recurring model review.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"No experience benefit for requesting, registration, study completion, naming, querying or mastery. An actual trial can yield verified information, including a measured failure, only to the participant who performed or directly observed it; an inspection reporting only unknowns is not verified information gain. Deduplicate by functional finding, material condition and evidence, not interface name or repeated inspection. If the existing experience ledger supports such events, cap a qualifying personal event at 0.2 short pleasure, at most once per 10 rounds for this activity class, decaying to zero over those 10 rounds. Familiar legitimate physical practice may also sustain modest satisfaction without novelty: at most 0.02 per paid participating round, capped at 0.2 attributable to this activity, with decay of 0.002 per inactive world round. Do not stack the two pathways for the same contribution. These are bounded event-driven effects, not guaranteed rewards for success or failure. If that integration is unavailable, record evidence without issuing experience until the coded dependency exists. Warmth grants no automatic comfort; actual thermal exposure must justify any comfort, with total physical comfort capped at 10. Basic nutrition is unchanged. Never modify protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions.\",\"visualReview\":\"Evaluate visuals independently of function and experience. Emit reusable friction-trial events and metadata containing work ID, actor, exact material IDs, location, stage, paid progress, contact orientation, elapsed time and observed outcome. Show inspection or rubbing only while actually performed; show pause, interruption and failure distinctly. Thermal metadata may display measured warmth without representing ignition. Dust or char appears only for actual material changes; smoke, glow, ember and flame require their respective modeled events. A real source carries source ID, provenance, remaining fuel, thermal state, intensity and extinction state for reuse by other interfaces. No success icon, sparks, fire, cooked-food visual or mastery display on request, study, unsupported contact, failed ignition or incomplete work. Do not expose hidden moisture, species or ignition thresholds through visual labels.\"}]}"}
